business_problem: DATEV wanted to modernize complex legacy applications for cloud-native environments while establishing an approach that could scale beyond a single project. Its teams also needed an operating model that combined acceleration and quality with knowledge transfer, and developers needed support adopting modern database architectures.
solution_summary: DATEV created a standalone Modernization Factory, with the work reporting to its C-level leadership and MongoDB executives aligned to clear organizational obstacles. In selected modernization initiatives, MongoDB's Application Modernization Platform (AMP) applies AI-assisted methods to analyze complex legacy systems and accelerate application modernization for cloud-native environments. The source describes an initial pilot that demonstrated the approach could work, followed by a repeatable operating model intended to combine acceleration, quality and knowledge transfer. DATEV developers work directly with MongoDB engineers on technical challenges; the day-to-day collaboration also helps legacy developers adopt NoSQL database technology and modern database architectures. The story does not detail data ingestion, persistence, runtime serving or a specific target architecture, so those components are not inferred.
